verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is code-first: agents are built as Python or Node.js programs, and the hands-on probes confirm the official `lk` CLI and the pip/npm SDKs run. That makes the programmatic surface the primary one, but the evidence never states that the browser-based no-code Agent Builder or Cloud deployment controls (such as instant rollback) are fully mirrored in the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that Agent Builder and Cloud dashboard actions (deploy, rollback) are exposed via the API or CLI, and API reference coverage of the management functions.
